title: Reproduced issue: with evaluate(False), S('Point2D(Integer(1),Integer(2))') raises 'Imaginary coordinates are not permitted.'
evidence_refs: run: python3 -c 'with sp.evaluate(False): sp.S(...)' -> ValueError: Imaginary coordinates are not permitted.

title: Fixed: im(a) -> im(a).is_zero is False in Point.__new__ so evaluate(False) no longer misflags real coords as imaginary
evidence_refs: run: python3 -c 'with sp.evaluate(False): sp.S(...)' -> Point2D(1, 2); plain and evaluate=False kwarg forms also work; Point2D(1, 2+I) still raises ValueError
run: pytest sympy/core/tests/test_sympify.py with vs without fix -> identical 7 pre-existing failures (env-related), 41 passed both
